(189)༄/ /rgyal ba'i sras po thogs med bzang po dpal gyis mdzad pa'i blo sbyong don bdun ma bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: "$ (189)༄// rgyal ba'i sras po thogs med bzang po dpal gyis mdzad pa'i blo sbyong don bdun ma bzhugs so//

(190)༄༅// thugs rje chen po la phyag 'tshal lo// bslab gsum rnam dag byang chub thugs gnyis 'byongs// bde gshegs bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas mdzad cing*// bstan 'dzin rnams kyi gtsug gi rgyan gyur pa'i// mtshungs med bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// dus gsum rgyal ba sras bcas bgrod gcig lam// phan bde ma lus 'byung ba'i rin chen gter// skal ldan slob mas yang yang bskul ba'i ngor// bla ma'i gsung la brten nas rnam par dbye// bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par 'dod pa'i gang zag rnams kyis byang chub tu sems bskyed nas/ kun rdzob dang*/ don dam pa'i byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa la 'bad par bya dgos te/ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis/ bdag nyid dang ni 'jig rten 'dis// bla med byang chub thob 'dod na// de yi rtsa ba byang chub sems// ri dbang rgyal po ltar brtan dang*// phyogs mtha' gtugs pa'i snying rje dang*// gnyis la mi brten ye shes lags// zhes gsungs shing*/ de sgom pa'i man ngag jo bo chen po rje lha gcig gis/ bla ma dharma rak+ṣi ta zhes bya ba/ rang gi sku sha bcad nas gzhan la byin zhing*/ byams snying rje 'ba' zhig bsgoms pas stong nyid kyi rtogs pa thugs la (191)'khrungs pa dang*/ yang bla ma byams pa'i rnal 'byor pa zhes bya ba/ gzhan gyi sdug bsngal bdag la dngos su len nus pa dang*/ bla ma gser gling pa dang gsum las thob pa las/ 'di bla ma gser gling pa'i lugs yin zhing*/ de la yang 'khrid tshul mi 'dra ba mang du yod kyang*/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'chad kha ba'i lugs kyis don bdun du mdzad de/ sngon 'gro rten gyi chos bstan pa dang*/ dngos gzhi byang chub kyi sems sbyong ba/ rkyen ngan byang chub kyi lam du khyer ba/ tshe gcig gi nyams len dril nas bstan pa/ blo 'byongs pa'i tshad/ blo sbyong gi dam tshig /blo sbyong gi bslab bya dang bdun gyi/

dang po ni/ dang po sngon 'gro dag la bslab// ces gsungs te/ dal 'byor rnyed par dka' ba dang*// 'chi ba mi rtag pa dang*/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsgom pa dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ chos sgrub pa'i rten dal 'byor gyi mi lus 'di thob pa la rgyu dge ba phun sum tshogs pa bsgrub dgos la// sems can gyi nang na dge ba rnam dag bsgrub pa nyung bas 'bras bu dal 'byor thob pa dka' la/ dud 'gro la sogs pa 'gro ba gzhan la ltos na dal 'byor thob pa srid tsam du 'dug pa las/ bdag gis da res dal 'byor (192)thob pa 'di/ don med par mi 'gyur bar chos rnam dag gcig byed dgos snyam du bsgom/ gnyis pa ni/ tshe la nges pa med cing 'chi ba'i rkyen shin tu mang bas/ de ring tsam yang mi 'chi ba'i gding yang mi 'dug pas/ da lta nyid nas dam pa'i chos la 'bad dgos snyam du bsgom/ gsum pa ni/ dge sdig las 'bras bu bde sdug 'byung bar gsungs pas/ sdig pa thams cad spong zhing*/ dge ba ci nus su bsgrub par bya'o snyam du bsgom// gnyis pa dngos gzhi byang chub kyi sems gnyis sbyong ba la/ don dam dang*/ kun rdzob byang sems sbyong ba gnyis las/ dang po la sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi sbyor ba ni/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du btang nas/ lha dang bla ma la gsol ba btab ste/ yan lag bdun pa phul nas lus drang por 'dug ste dbugs phyir 'gro dang*/ nang 'gro nyi shu rtsa gcig gi bar du ma 'khrugs pa lhag chad med par bgrangs te/ 'dis bsam gtan gyi snod du rung bar 'gyur ro// dngos gzhi ni/ chos rnams rmi lam lta bur bsam// zhes gsungs te/ 'di ltar gzung ba'i yul du snang ba'i snod bcud 'di dag thams cad rmi lam dang 'dra ste/ rang gi sems nyid 'khrul nas de ltar snang ba yin gyis sems las logs su gyur pa cung zad tsam yang med par sgro 'dogs bcad/ sems nyid bden nam snyam na/

ma skyes rig pa'i gshis la dpyod// ces gsungs ste/ sems nyid skye 'gags gnas gsum gyis stong zhing*/ kha dog dang dbyibs la sogs pa med la/ lus kyi phyi nang gang na'ang mi gnas pas/ gshis cir yang ma grub pas gang du yang mi 'dzin par rtog med kyi ngang la bzhag go /de'i tshe lus sems thams cad stong pa'o snyam pa'i gnyen po'i (193)rnam rtog byung na/ gnyen po nyid kyang rang sar grol// zhes gsungs te/ gnyen po de nyid kyi ngo bo la bltas te/ rang bzhin med par shes par byas nas de'i ngang la bzhag go /de'i 'jog tshul bstan pa'i phyir// lam gyi ngo bo kun gzhi'i ngang la gzhag ces gsungs te/ rnam shes tshogs bdun gyi spro bsdu thams cad dang phral nas/ gshis cir yang ma grub pa la blos cir yang mi 'dzin pa rtog med kyi ngang la gsal sing nge bzhag go /gsum pa rjes ni// thun mtshams sgyu ma'i skyes bur bya// zhes gsungs te/ mnyam bzhag gi nyams kyi rjes su 'brangs nas/ rang gzhan snod bcud ci snang thams cad sgyu ma ltar snang yang bden pa med par shes par byas la spyod lam thams cad spyod do// gnyis pa kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa la/ mnyam rjes gnyis las/ mnyam bzhag ni/ gtong len gnyis po spel mar sbyang*/ zhes gsungs te/ 'di shin tu gal che ste/ slob dpon chen po zhi ba lhas// gang zhig bdag dang gzhan rnams ni// myur du bskyab par 'dod pa des// bdag dang gzhan du brje bya ba// gsang ba'i dam pa spyad par bya// zhes pa dang*/ bdag bde gzhan gyi sdug bsngal dag /yang dag brje bar ma byas na// sangs rgyas nyid ni mi 'grub cing*// 'khor ba na yang bde ba med// ces pa dang*/ de ltar bdag gnod zhi ba dang*// gzhan gyi sdug bsngal zhi bya'i phyir// bdag nyid gzhan la btang ba dang*// gzhan rnams bdag bzhin bsrung bar bya/ zhes gsungs pas// thog mar rang gi rtsa ba'i ma gsal bar dmigs te/

'dis bdag lto na gnas pa nas bzung ste/ chud ma zos par bskyangs pas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang mjal zhing*/ lam (194)bsgrub tu byung bas shin tu drin che/ tshe 'di kho nar ma zad kyis 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas/ byams pa'i mig gis bltas/ brtse ba'i sems kyis bzung*/ gnod pa las bskyabs/ phan bde bsgrubs pas shin tu drin che/ de ltar bdag gi don byed nas/ 'dis 'khor bar sdug bsngal sna tshogs myong ba re snying rje snyam du yid drag tu bsgoms la/ da ni ngas kyang 'di la lan du phan gdags/ gnod pa bsal bar bya'o// 'di la gang gis gnod na/ sdug bsngal dang kun 'byung gis gnod de/ sdug bsngal gyis dngos su gnod cing*/ kun 'byung gis brgyud nas gnod pas de gnyis ngas blang snyam du bsams la/ ma'i rgyud la yod pa'i sdug bsngal kun 'byung thams cad ma lus par rang gi snying gi nang du byung bar bsgom zhing*/ byung na dga' ba'i 'dun pa drag tu bya'o// ma la cis phan na bde ba dang dge bas phan pas/ bdag gi bde ba dang dge ba thams cad rang 'dod la ltos pa med par ma la btang bas/ ma de 'phral la bde zhing chos bsgrub pa'i mthun rkyen thams cad 'dzom nas/ 'phral la 'tshang rgya bar nus pa tsam du gyur par bsgom zhing*/ de ltar gyur na dga' ba'i 'dun pa drag tu bskyed do// de bzhin tu pha la sogs pa la yang bsgom ste/ mthar sems can thams cad la yang bsgom par bya'o// de yang 'di ltar sems can thams cad kyang thog ma med pa nas bdag gi pha mar gyur te/ phan dpag tu med pa btags pas shin tu drin che la/ drin can de rnams 'khor bar sdug bsngal sna tshogs kyis gtses pas/ de dag sdug bsngal de dag dang bral na ci ma rung snyam pa'i snying rje drag tu bsgom pa la/ de dag gi sdug bsngal thams cad bdag la thim zhing*/ bdag gi lus longs spyod dus gsum gyi dge ba rnams de rnams (195)la btang bas de rnams bde zhing*/

dge ba 'phel bar bsam zhing*/ de ltar gyur na dga' ba'i 'dun pa drag tu bya'o// bdag gzhan brje ba'i blo de skye sla bar bya ba'i phyir/ de gnyis rlung la bskyon par bya/ zhes gsungs te/ rlung phar 'gro ba na de dang 'grogs nas bdag gi bde dge thams cad gzhan la song zhing*/ tshur 'ong ba na gzhan gyi sdig sdug thams cad bdag la byung bar bsgom mo// gnyis pa rjes thob ni/ yul gsum dug gsum dge rtsa gsum/ zhes gsungs te/ yul yid du 'ong mi 'ong bar ma gsum la brten nas/ chags sdang rmongs gsum skyes pa na/ bdag ltar yul gsum la brten nas/ dug gsum skyes pa'i sems can mang po yod pas/ de rnams kyi dug gsum thams cad bdag lang dus nas/ de rnams chags sdang gti mug med pa'i dge ba gsum dang ldan par gyur cig snyam du bsgom mo// de la dran pa bskul ba'i phyir/ spyod lam kun tu tshig gis sbyang*/ zhes gsungs te/ sems can rnams kyi sdig pa dang sdug bsngal thams cad bdag la smin zhing*/ bdag gi bde dang dge ba thams cad sems can rnams la smin par gyur cig /ces brjod cing 'dun pa drag tu bya'o// gzhan gyi sdug bsngal bdag la len nus par bya ba'i phyir/ len pa'i go rim rang nas brtsam/ zhes gsungs te/ bdag la ma 'ongs pa na 'byung ba'i sdug bsngal rnams da lta blangs pas rgyud gzhan gyi sdug bsngal yang len nus par 'gyur ro// gsum pa rkyen ngan byang chub kyi lam du khyer ba ni/ snod bcud sdig pas gang ba'i tshe// rkyen ngan byang chub lam du bsgyur/ zhes gsungs te/ sdig pa'i 'bras bus snod kyi 'byor pa nyams pa dang sems can ma rung pa la sogs pas/ sdug bsngal mang po byung ba na/ de nyid byang chub kyi lam du bsgyur (196)ba la/ bsam sbyor gnyis las/ bsam pa la yang kun rdzob dang*/ don dam byang sems kyis rkyen ngan byang chub kyi lam du bsgyur ba'o// dang po ni/

sdug bsngal byung ba thams cad sngar bdag 'dzin la dgrar ma shes shing*/ sems can rnams drin che bar ma shes pas lan pas/ da sdug bsngal thams cad bdag 'dzin gyis nyes par bstan pa'i phyir/ le lan thams cad gcig la bda'/ zhes gsungs te/ bdag la sdug bsngal ci byung yang rang nyid kyis rang la bdag tu bzung bas lan pa yin pas/ gzhan la khag mi skur te// 'jig rten dag na 'tshe ba gang yod dang*// 'jigs dang sdug bsngal ji snyed yod gyur pa// de kun bdag tu 'dzin pa las byung na// 'dre chen des ko bdag la ci zhig bya/ zhes gsungs pas/ thog ma med pa nas bdag med la bdag tu bzung nas de'i gces spras kyi phyir gzhan la gnod pa la sogs pa'i las bsags pas/ 'khor bar ngan song la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal thams cad byung ba yin te/ spyod 'jug las// yid khyod rang don byed 'dod pas// bskal pa grangs med 'das gyur kyang*// ngal ba chen po de lta bus// khyod kyis sdug bsngal 'ba' zhig bsgrubs/ zhes gsungs so// de ltar sdug bsngal ba dang*/ 'dzin gyis bskyed pas/ bdag 'dzin de la dgrar bltas te/ bdag med la bdag tu 'dzin pa'i blo 'dis// 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas da lta'i bar du sdug bsngal thams cad skyed cing*/ mtho ba la phrag dog /dma' ba la brnyas bcos mnyam pa la 'gran sems thams cad 'di las byung zhing*/ bdag 'khor ba las mthar ba dang*/ mi dang mi ma yin pa'i gnod pa la sogs pa sdug bsngal thams cad 'dis byas pa yin te/ spyod 'jug las// 'di yis brgya phrag thams (197)cad du// 'khor bar bdag la gnod pa byas// da ni mkhon rnams dran byas te// khyod kyis rang don sems pa gzhom/ zhes gsungs pas/ bdag 'dzin nam byung tsa na brtags na bdag gang yang mi 'dug pa la// ci'i phyir bdag tu 'dzin zhes bdag 'dzin nam skyes dus 'phral la spangs la/ phyin chad bdag gces 'dzin mi skye bar bya ba'i phyir 'bad par bya ste/

spyod 'jug las// khyod kyis kho bo gar brlag pa'i// sngon gyi dus de gzhan yin gyis// ngas mthong da khyod gang du 'gro// khyod kyis dregs pa kun gzhom bya/ zhes gsungs so// des na gnod pa ci byung yang bdag 'dzin gyi 'gong po 'dis lan pa yin pas/ 'di ci thul la 'bad par bya ste/ sha bo pa'i zhal nas/ da res kyi tshe thung 'di la/ 'gong po 'di ci thul cig bya 'tshal gsungs// yang rang don bsgrub pa'i bsam sbyor la mi skye'i ming dang*/ gzhan don bsgrub pa'i bsam sbyor la chos pa'i ming gis btags la/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'ban gyi phyag len ltar spang blang bya'o// dge bshes 'ban gyi zhal nas/ da ni sems kyi mkhar sgor gnyen po'i mdung thung gcig mnan la bsdad pa min pa gzhan bya rgyu med/ kho sgrim na nga yang sgrim/ kho glod na nga yang glod gsungs/ bdag 'dzin la dgrar bltas nas spong ba 'di la/ sha bo ba'i zhal nas/ 'go po 'gong rdzongs kyi chos zhes gsung ngo*// de ltar bdag 'dzin la dgrar bltas nas gzhan gces par gzung ba'i phyir/ kun la bka' drin che bar bsgom/ zhes gsungs te/ spyir sems can thams cad thog ma med pa nas kyi pha ma drin can yin pas/ sngar yang drin che la/ bla na med pa'i byang chub bsgrub pa yang sems can la rag las te/ spyod 'jug las// sems can rnams dang rgyal ba la// (198)sangs rgyas chos 'grub 'dra ba la// rgyal la gus byed de bzhin tu// sems can la min ci yi tshul/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ sangs rgyas bsgrub pa'i gang zag la sangs rgyas dang sems can la drin mnyam pa'i tshod yin pas/ de ltar drin che ba'i sems can rnams la/ byams pa dang snying rje drag tu bsgoms nas/ de dag gi sdig sdug bdag la blang zhing*/ bdag gi bde dge de rnams la sbyin par bya'o// khyad par du bdag la gnod pa byed pa'i mi'am mi ma yin byung na gnod byed 'dis thog ma med pa nas bdag gi ma byas nas/

kho rang gi sdig sdug gtam ngan la ma 'dzem par bdag gi don byed byed nas 'khor bar sdug bsngal sna tshogs myong zhing*/ 'khrul pa'i stobs kyis sngon gyi nye du yin pa ngo ma shes pa dang*/ bdag gi las ngan gyis bskul nas/ 'dis da lta bdag la gnod pa'i sdig pa byas pas/ phyis de'i 'bras bus sdug bsngal myong bar 'gyur bas/ bdag la brten nas 'di dus ring por sdug bsngal myong zhing*/ myong bar 'gyur bar 'dug pas re snying rje snyam du drag tu bsgom/ sngar ni ngas 'di la gnod pa 'ba' zhig byas 'dug da ni 'di'i gnod pa byas la zhing phan pa bsgrub par bya'o snyam du bsams la/ gtong len drag tu bsgom/ khyad par du mi'am khyi lta bu dngos su mthong ba yin na/ de la dngos su phan ci thogs la 'bad cing*/ gang ltar byas kyang dngos su phan gdags ma nus na'ang*/ bsam pas gnod byed 'di sdug bsngal dang bral bde ba dang ldan sangs rgyas myur du thob par gyur cig snyam du zhe thag pa nas ngag tu yang brjod par bya/ yang da phyin chad/ bdag gi dge ba ci byed rnams 'di'i don du bya'o snyam pa'i sems bskyed par bya'o// yang gnod byed lha 'dre yin na/ ngas thog ma med pa nas khyod kyi sha khrag la sogs pa zos (199)'thungs pas/ de'i lan du bdag gi sha khrag la sogs pa khyod la sbyin par bya'o snyam du bsams la/ gnod byed de'i mdun du rang gi lus blos kha phye ste/ bdag gi sha khrag rus pa la sogs gang 'dod pa khyod zo zhig snyam du blos lings bsgyur zhing*/ ngag tu yang brjod par bya'o// de nas gnod byed des bdag gi sha zos pas bkres skom la sogs pa zhi nas lus sems zag med kyi bde bas gang zhing*/ byang chub kyi sems gnyis 'byongs par bsam/ de bzhin tu sha khrag za ba'i lha 'dre'i rigs ji snyed yod pa thams cad la bdag gi lus sngar ltar byin pas/ thams cad tshims nas bde zhing dge bar gyur par bsam/

de ltar na nyes pa thams cad bdag gces 'dzin las byung 'dug pas de la dgrar bltas la/ phan bde thams cad sems can las byung bar 'dug pas/ de dag la gnyen du bltas la phan ci thogs bya/ glang ri thang pa'i zhal nas/ ngas ji tsam gyi chos zab mo gcig zhal phye ste bltas kyang skyon thams cad rang gi yin/ yon tan thams cad jo bo sems can gyi yin par 'dug /de'i gnad kas khe dang rgyal kha gzhan la phyin/ gyong dang bub ka rang gis len pa 'di min pa go rgyu med gsungs/ don dam byang chub kyi sems kyis rkyen ngan lam du bsgyur ba ni// 'khrul snang sku bzhir bsgom pa yi// stong nyid bsrung ba bla na med/ ces gsungs te/ nyon mongs pa dang phyi nang snod bcud kyi gnod pa la brten pa'i sdug bsngal gang byung yang*/ nyon mongs pa dang sdug bsngal 'di thams cad rang gi sems 'khrul pa'i snang ba 'di yin pas bden par grub pa cung zad kyang med/ kun rdzob tu de ltar snang ba ni/ rmi lam du mes tshig pa'am/ chus khyer nas nyam thag pa ltar mi bden pa la bden par bzung bas (200)nyes pa yin/ don dam par ni chos thams cad cir yang grub pa med pas/ nyon mongs sam sdug bsngal de'i ngo bo la bltas na/ de dang po gang nas ma skyes pas skye med chos sku yin/ ma skyes pa la 'gag rgyu med pas 'gag med longs sku yin/ skye 'gag med pa la bar du gnas pa med pa de sprul sku yin/ de rnams ngo bo dbyer med pa ngo bo nyid kyi sku yin pas/ 'khrul snang nyid sku bzhir blta ba 'di sku bzhi ngo sprod kyi gdams ngag bya ba yin gsung ngo*// gzhan yang gnod byed 'dis bdag byang chub kyi sems gnyis sbyong ba'i bskul ma byas pas kyang bka' drin che/ bdag gnyen po dang bral nas/ nyon mongs pa skyes pa ma tshor ba la 'dis sbren pas/ bla ma'am sangs rgyas kyi sprul pa yin snyam du bsam/ yang mdze nad la sogs pa sdug bsngal drag po byung na/

sdug bsngal 'di med na bdag tshe 'di'i shom ral song nas/ chos mi dran par 'dug pa la 'dis chos dran du btsud nas/ 'di bla ma dkon mchog gi phrin las yin snyam du bsam/ mdor na bla ma la brten nas byang chub kyi sems skye ba ltar/ gnod byed dam sdug bsngal 'di dag la brten nas bdag la byang chub kyi sems gnyis skye bar 'dug pas/ 'di dag gis go bcad snyam du zhe thag pa nas bsam mo// sbyor ba khyad par can bsags sbyong gnyis kyis skyen ngan lam du bsgyur ba ni sbyor ba bzhi ldan thabs kyi mchog ces gsungs te/ dang po tshogs bsag pa'i sbyor ba ni/ bdag la sdug bsngal byung ba na/ sdug bsngal 'di med na dga' ste snyam pa'i bsam pa 'byung bas de'i tshe khyod sdug bsngal mi 'dod cing bde ba 'dod na/ bde ba'i rgyu tshogs sogs shig pa'i brda yin gyis snyam pa byas la/ bla ma dkon mchog gi mchod (201)pa/ dge 'dun gyi bsnyen bkur/ 'byung po'i gtor ma la sogs pa mdor na lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgo nas tshogs gsog pa la 'bad nas/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bya ste/ bla ma dkon cog la maṇ+ḍal phul la gsol ba drag tu btab nas/ bdag na ba legs na na bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ sos pa legs na sos par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ shi ba legs na 'chi bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol// zhes re dogs 'gog pa'i gsol ba gdab bo// sbyor ba gnyis pa sdig pa sbyang ba ni// khyod sdug bsngal mi 'dod na sdug bsngal gyi rgyu sdig spongs shig pa'i brda yin gyis snyam pa byas la/ sngar byas kyi sdig pa la 'gyod pa rnam par sun 'byin pa'i stobs dang*/ phyin chad srog la babs kyang mi byed snyam pa'i nyes pa las ldog pa'i stobs dang*/ dkon cog la skyabs su 'gro zhing byang chub tu sems bskyed pa sogs rten gyi stobs dang*/ stong pa nyid bsgom pa dang*/ gzungs sngags khyad par can zlos pa la sogs pa gnyen po kun tu spyod pa'i stobs dang*/

stobs bzhi'i sgo nas sdig bshags tshad du lang bar bya'o// sbyor ba gsum pa gdon la mchod pa ni/ gtor ma phul te// khyod kyis bdag gi byang chub kyi sems sbyong ba'i grogs byas pas bka' drin che/ da dung sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal bdag la smin par mdzad du gsol zhes zhe thag pa nas gsol ba gdab bo// de ltar mi nus na gtor ma byin/ byams snying rje bsgoms la/ ngas khyod la 'phral dang yun du gang phan phan bya yis/ nga yi chos kyi bar chad ma byed cig ces bsgo bar bya'o// sbyor ba bzhi pa chos skyong la mchod pa ni/ chos skyong la gtor ma phul la/ chos (202)kyi 'gal rkyen zhi ba dang*// mthun rkyen 'grub par gsol ba gdab bo// rkyen glo bur ba lam du slong ba'i phyir// 'phral la gang thug bsgom du sbyar// zhes gsungs te/ nad dang gdon dang dgra la sogs pa glo bur du byung nas sdug bsngal drag po byung na/ 'jig rten gyi khams na 'di lta bu'i sdug bsngal byung ba dpag tu med pa yod pas/ de rnams re snying rje snyam du bsams la/ de dag gi sdug bsngal thams cad bdag la 'ubs kyis bsdu/ yang na gnod byed 'dis bdag byang chub kyi sems sbyong ba'i grogs byas pas/ bla ma ltar bka' drin che snyam du bsam/ yang gzhan sdug bsngal ba mthong na yang*/ de ma thag tu bdag la blang zhing rang ngam gzhan la nyon mongs pa drag po skyes na yang*/ gzhan gyi nyon mongs pa thams cad bdag la 'dus par gyur cig snyam du zhe thag pa nas bsam mo// rkyen ngan lam du bya thabs 'di thams cad kyis re dogs gnyis 'gog pa yin/ mthar thug re dogs gnyis dang bral ba'i lam la skyel yang*/ da lta'i dus na dgra zin gnyis su byas nas sbyong ba ni shing 'khyog po bsrang ba dang 'dra'o zhes glang ri thang pa gsung ngo*// bzhi pa tshe gcig gi nyams len dril nas bstan pa ni/ man ngag snying po mdor bsdus pa// stobs lnga dag dang sbyor bar bya// zhes gsungs pas// dang po 'phen pa'i stobs ni da nas bzung ste/

zla ba 'di dang*/ lo 'di dang*/ ma shi'i bar dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi bar du byang chub kyi sems gnyis dang mi 'bral bar bya'o zhes 'phen pa drag po yang yang bya'o// goms pa'i stobs ni/ yang dang yang du byang chub kyi sems gnyis sbyong ba'o// dkar po sa bon gyi stobs ni/ byang chub kyi sems skye ba dang 'phel ba'i don du ci nus pa'i tshogs gsog pa'o// sun 'byin pa'i (203)stobs ni/ bdag gces 'dzin gyi rnam rtog nam byung ba na/ 'dis thog ma med pa nas sdug bsngal sna tshogs la sbyar/ tshe 'dir yang sdug bsngal dang sdig pa dang chos 'dod pa bzhin ma byung ba la sogs pa thams cad 'dis byas pa yin snyam du bsams la/ bdag gces 'dzin gyi rnam rtog rgyangs kyis spang bar bya'o// smon lam gyi stobs ni/ dge sbyor thams cad kyi gsham du/ da nas sangs rgyas ma thob kyi bar du byang chub kyi sems gnyis sbyong ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig /rkyen ngan ci byung thams cad chos 'di'i grogs su 'khyer bar gyur cig /ces smon lam gdab cing*/ bla ma dkon cog dang chos skyong la mchod pa dang*/ gtor ma phul nas/ de ltar 'gyur bar mdzad du gsol zhes gsol ba gdab bo// stobs lnga po 'di chos thams cad hūm̐ gcig tu dril ba'i chos yin gsung ngo*// 'o na chos 'di'i lugs kyis 'da' kha ma'i gdams ngag ji ltar byed ce na/ theg chen 'pho ba'i gdams ngag ni/ stobs lnga nyid yin spyod lam gces// zhes gsungs te/ chos 'di la sbyangs pa'i gang zag de/ 'chi nges pa'i nad kyis thebs pa na/ dang po dkar po sa bon gyi lag len ni/ yo byad thams cad bla ma dkon cog mchod pa la sogs bsod nams gang che sar btang la/ de rnams la chags zhen med par bya/ de nas smon lam gyi stobs ni/ bla ma dkon cog la yan lag bdun pa phul la/ bdag bar do dang*/ tshe rabs phyi ma thams cad du byang chub kyi sems gnyis sbyong bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol// chos 'di ston pa'i bla ma dang mjal bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol// zhes gsol ba drag tu btab cing de ltar smon lam yang gdab bo// de nas sun 'byin pa'i stobs ni/

bdag gces 'dzin gyi rnam rtog 'dis sngar yang sdug tu bcug /da dung (204)'di dang ma bral na bder mi ster bar 'dug cing*/ de ltar yang bdag gi lus 'di la gces par bzung bas sdug bsngal bar 'dug ste/ brtags na lus sems gang la yang bdag tu bzung rgyu mi 'dug snyam du shes par byas la bdag 'dzin spangs la bzhag go /de nas 'phen pa'i stobs ni/ ngas bar dor yang byang chub kyi sems gnyis sbyang bar bya'o snyam pa'i 'dun pa drag po yang yang bya'o// de nas goms pa'i stobs ni/ sngar gyi byang chub kyi sems gnyis sbyong tshul de dran par byed pa'o// spyod lam ni 'chi khar gzhog g.yas 'og tu bcug /lag pa g.yas la 'gram pa brten te/ mthe'u chung gis sna bug g.yas bkag la/ rlung g.yon nas rgyu bar bya'o// de nas byams snying rje sngon du 'gro bas/ rlung 'gro 'ong la bskyon nas gtong len gnyis po sbyong*/ de'i rjes la 'khor 'das skye 'chi la sogs pa thams cad sems snang yin sems nyid cir yang ma grub par shes pa'i ngang la blos cir yang mi 'dzin par bzhag go /de ltar byang chub kyi sems gnyis po de spel zhing bsgom pa'i 'phro la 'chi bar bya'o// 'chi kha ma'i gdams ngag la 'ud che ba mang ste/ 'di las ngo mtshar che ba med gsungs/ lnga pa blo 'byongs pa'i tshad bstan pa ni// chos kun dgos pa gcig tu 'dus// zhes pa la sogs pa ste/ theg pa che chung gi chos thams cad kyi dgos pa ni bdag 'dzin 'dul bar 'dus pas/ bdag 'dzin gyi gnyen por ma song na chos byas tshad don med du song ba yin/ chos byas tshad bdag 'dzin gyi gnyen por 'gro yin 'dug na blo sbyong rgyud la skyes pa'i rtags yin/ chos chos su song ma song gi khyad par 'di na yod pas/ 'di chos pa srang la 'jal ba'i rgya ma yin gsungs/ dpang po gnyis kyi gtso bo bzung*// zhes pa ni/ gzhan dag na re/ jo bo de kun gyi rgyud la chos skyes (205)'dug

/chos pa bzang po bya ba de la zer ba yin/ zhes gzhan gyis ma khrel ba yang dpang po yin mod kyis de gtsor mi bzung ste/ 'jig rten phal pa rnams kyis bdag gi sems mi rtogs pas/ phyi'i spyod lam sna re tsam mthong bas kyang mgu srid pas so// des na rang gi sems kyis ma khrel ba cig dpang po'i gtso bo yin pas/ blo gzu bos legs par brtags pas/ rang la rang gis ma khrel na blo 'byongs pa'i rtags yin pas gnyen po bskyed la/ rang la rang gis ma khrel ba la 'bad par bya'o// yid bde 'ba' zhig rgyun du bsten// zhes pa ni/ blo legs par sbyangs pa'i stobs kyis da phyin chad rkyen ngan ci byung yang*/ blo sbyong gi lan du khyer bas chog snyam pa'i blo gding 'chos na blo 'byongs pa'i tshad yin pas/ rkyen ngan ci byung yang de la dga' ba bsgoms nas de'i steng du gzhan gyi rkyen ngan thams cad kyang len pa la nyam nga ba med pa la bslab par bya'o// yengs kyang thub na 'byongs pa yin// zhes pa ni/ rta rtsal can de yengs kyang rta las mi lhung ba ltar/ ma brtags par glo bur du gnod byed la sogs rkyen ngan byung ba na zhe sdang la sogs mi skye bar rkyen ngan de nyid blo sbyong gi grogs su khad kyis 'gro yin 'dug na blo 'byongs pa'i ched yin pas/ de ltar 'gyur ba la 'bad nas bslab par bya'o// 'byongs pa'i tshad 'di dag ni/ blo sbyong rgyud la skyes pa'i rtags yin gyis 'byongs zer nas da sbyang mi dgos pa ni ma yin pas/ rtags 'di dag byung nas kyang 'bad nas blo sbyang bar bya'o// drug pa blo sbyong gi dam tshig bstan pa ni/ spyi don gsum la rtag tu bslab// ces pa la sogs pa gsungs te/ spyi don gsum ni/ blo sbyong khas blangs dang ma 'gal ba/ tho cor ma shor ba/ phyogs rer ma lhung ba'o// dang po ni/ nga blo sbyong ba yin zer nas bslab pa phra mo khyad du (206)gsod pa spangs te/

bsam pa blo sbyong dang ldan pa'i sgo nas so thar nas rdo rje theg pa'i bar rang gis ji ltar khas blangs pa'i bslab pa rnams ma nyams par bsrung bar bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ bdag gces 'dzin med par gzhan gyis go bar bya ba'i phyir/ shing gnyan po gcod pa dang*/ mdze pho dang 'grogs pa la sogs pa tho co'i spyod pa rnams blangs te/ dge bshes ston pas rwa sgreng du bstan pa'i srol btsugs pa'i bka' gdams kyi rnam thar dang mi 'gal bar bya'o// gsum pa ni/ mi'i gnod pa bzod la lha 'dre'i gnod pa mi bzod pa dang*/ che ba la gus la chung ba la brnyas pa dang*/ gnyen la byams la dgra la sdang ba la sogs pa phyogs re ba thams cad spangs la thams cad 'byongs par bslab bo// 'dun pa bsgyur la rang sor bzhag /ces pa ni/ bsam pa sngar rang gces par 'dzin pa de/ da bdag pas gzhan gces par bsgyur la/ lus ngag gi spyod pa grogs chos mthun rnams dang 'dra bar so thub par bya ste/ blo sbyong thams cad mngon tshan chung la chod che ba zhig bya dgos gsungs pas/ gzhan gyis ma tshor bar rgyud smin pa zhig bya'o// yan lag nyams pa brjod mi bya// zhes pa ni/ gzhan la 'jig rten pa'i skyon zhar ba la sogs pa dang*/ chos kyi skyon tshul khrims 'chal ba la sogs pa mi snyan pa'i tshig rnams mi brjod pa'o// gzhan phyogs gang yang mi bsam mo// zhes pa ni/ spyir sems can thams cad dang*/ khyad par du chos sgor zhugs pa rnams la skyon mthong na nga rang snang ba ma dag pa yin gyis/ khong la de 'dra'i skyon yod nyen med snyam du bsams la/ skyon rtog pa'i blo de bzlog par bya'o// nyon mongs gang tshe sngon la sbyong*// zhes pa ni/ rang rgyud la nyon mongs pa gang che brtags nas/ gang che ba de'i gnyen por chos thams cad spungs nas de (207)nyid thog mar gdul lo// 'bras bu re ba thams cad spang*// zhes pa ni/ blo sbyong byas pas tshe 'di'i rnyed bkur la sogs pa dang*/

phyi ma la lha mi'i bde ba dang*/ rang nyid mya ngan las 'das pa thob par 'dod pa la sogs pa rang don thams cad spang bar bya'o// dug can gyi zas spang*/ zhes pa ni/ dngos po bden 'dzin dang*/ bdag gces 'dzin gyi rnam rtog dang 'dres pa'i dge sbyor thams cad zas dug dang 'dres pa dang 'dra bas de spang bar bya'o// gzhung bzang po ma bsten/ zhes pa ni/ pha rol gyi gnod pa byas pa la khon du bzung nas khon 'dzin de las nam yang mi ldog pa de spang bar bya'o// shag ngan ma dgod/ ces pa ni/ gzhan gyis tshig ngan smras pa'i lan du/ gzhan gyi blo la gnod pa'i tshig ngan mi smra zhing*/ nyes pa byung na 'dis lan zhes mi smra ba'o// 'phrang ma sgug /ces pa ni/ gzhan gyis gnod pa byas pa zhe la bzhag nas/ gnod pa'i lan 'jal ba'i dus byung tsa na 'jal ba de spong ba'o// gnod la mi dbab/ ces pa ni/ mi'i skyon mtshang nas 'bru ba dang*/ mi ma yin pa la srog sngags zlos pa la sogs pa gzhan gyi sems la gnod pa drag po 'byung ba'i spyod lam mi byed pa'o// mdzo khal glang la ma 'byo// zhes pa ni/ rang la 'bab pa'i gcu gal lam khag ngan g.yo sgyu'i sgo nas gzhan la bskyur ba khong skyon can gyi spyod pa de lta bu spong ba'o// mgyogs kyi rtse ma gtod/ ces pa ni/ longs spyod thun mong ba la thabs sna tshogs kyi sgo nas bdag gis thob par byed pa'i bsam sbyor spong ba'o// gto log mi bya/ zhes pa ni/ phug rang bzang bar 'dod nas gzhan la pham kha len pa dang*/ 'dre gdon nam nad zhi bar 'dod nas blo sbyong ba ni/ gto bcos dang 'dra bas rang 'dod spang bar bya'o// (208)tshan gcig gi rnam rtog la blo sbyong 'di/ 'dre gdon la phan pa'i thabs gcig tu go ba 'dra ste/ de cug byed na bon byed pa dang khyad med/ chos bya ba nyon mongs pa dang rnam rtog gi gnyen por 'gro ba zhig dgos pa yin gsungs/ lha bdud du mi dbab/

ces pa ni/ 'jig rten pa kun gyi rang gi lha ma mgu nas/ rang la gnod pa byas na lha bdud du babs zer ba ltar blo sbyong gi sgo nas nga rgyal dang rloms sems chen po byas na chos chos min du song ba yin/ blo sbyong gis rang rgyud 'dul dgos pa yin pa la/ nga rgyal gyis rang rgyud lhag par rengs na chos gnad du ma song ste/ 'dre shar sgo nas gnod pa la/ glud nub sgor skyel ba dang 'dra ste/ des na sman nad thog tu btang zhing*/ bdag gces 'dzin spangs la/ kun la bran gyi tha ma ltar bya'o gsungs/ skyid kyi yan lag tu sdug ma tshol// zhes pa ni/ rang gi nye du dang grogs mched la sogs pa shi na/ de dag gi zas nor dang dpe cha la sogs pa nga la yong*/ yon bdag la na tsha shi chad byung na tshogs gsog yong*/ rang dang mnyam pa'i sgom chen shi na nga gcig pu la sku bsod yong*/ dgra shi na gnod byed mi yong bas nga 'tshengs snyam pa lta bu/ rang skyid pa'i thabs su gzhan sdug par 'dod pa spang ngo*// bdun pa blo sbyong gi bslab bya bstan pa ni/ blo sbyong mi nyams shing 'phel bar 'gyur ba'i thabs la slob pa ste/ de la/ rnal 'byor thams cad gcig gis bya// zhes pa ni/ zas dang gos kyi rnal 'byor la sogs pa thams cad gzhan phan gyi sems 'ba' zhig gis byed pa'o// log gnon thams cad gcig gis bya// zhes pa ni/ blo sbyong bsgoms pas na tsha 'dre gdon dang*/ mi kha sdang ba dang rang gi nyon mongs cher song ba la sogs pa byung nas/ blo sbyong snying mi 'dod pa byung na/ 'jig rten gyi khams na bdag (209)gi nyes pa 'di lta bu byung ba'i sems can mang po yod pas de rnams re snying rje snyam du bsams nas/ de dag gi nyes pa de rnams bdag la 'dus par gyur cig snyam du bsam zhing*/ gtong len bsgom par bya'o// thog mtha' gnyis la bya ba gnyis// zhes pa ni/ snga do'i tshe de ring byang chub kyi sems gnyis dang mi 'bral bar bya dgos snyam pa'i 'phen pa btang nas/

nyin mo yang de bzhin tu dran shes kyis zin par byas la dgong mo nyal ba nyin par gyi spyod pa rnams la brtags te/ byang chub kyi sems dang 'gal ba byung na// bdag la rngan bgrangs te bshags pa byas la// phyis de mi 'byung bar bya ba'i blo bskyed// ma 'gal ba 'dug na dga' ba bsgoms te// phyis kyang de bzhin tu bya'o snyam du bsam mo// gnyis po gang byung bzod par bya// zhes pa ni/ 'khor dang longs spyod la sogs pa phun sum tshogs pa byung na/ des ma dregs par de dag sgyu ma lta bur shes pa dang*/ gzhan la phan pa'i thabs su ci 'gyur bya zhing*/ shin tu rgud de 'og nas 'gro ba chu las med pa byung na yang de yang sgyu ma lta bur shes pa dang*/ gzhan gyi rgud pa thams cad bdag la len pa'i sgo nas zhum pa med par bya'o// gnyis po srog dang bsdos la bsrung*// zhes pa ni/ chos spyi'i dam tshig dang*/ khyad par blo sbyong gi dam tshig gnyis med na/ 'di phyi'i bde ba gang yang mi 'byung bas dam tshig de gnyis srog bas kyang gces par bsrung ba'o// dka' ba gsum la bslab par bya// zhes pa ni/ nyon mongs pa skyes pa na/ dang po dran pa dka'/ bar du bzlog pa dka'/ mtha' mar rgyun chod pa dka' bas/ dang po nam skyes pa na ngos zin par byas la/ bar du gnyen po'i stobs bskyed nas spangs la/ mthar phyis mi 'byung bar bya ba'i phyir 'bad par bya'o// rgyu yi gtso bo rnam (210)gsum blangs// zhes pa ni/ chos bsgrub pa'i rgyu'i gtso bo bla ma bzang po dang mjal ba dang*/ rang gi blo las su rung bas chos tshul bzhin tu nyams su longs pa dang*/ chos bsgrub pa la dgos pa'i mthun rkyen 'dzom pa ste/ de gsum rang la tshang na dga' ba bsgom zhing*/ gzhan la'ang de gsum tshang bar smon lam gdab/ rang la de gsum ma tshang na/ 'jig rten gyi khams na bdag ltar rgyu'i gtso bo gsum ma tshang bas/ chos rnam la ma byung ba mang po yod pas de rnams re snying rje snyam du bsams la/

de rnams kyi rgyu gsum ma tshang ba'i nyes pa thams cad bdag la smin nas/ de dag la rgyu gsum tshang bar gyur cig snyam du zhe thag pa nas bsgom/ nyam pa med pa rnam gsum bsgom// zhes pa ni/ theg pa chen po'i yon tan thams cad bla ma'i mos gus la rag lus pas/ bla ma'i mos gus nyams pa med pa dang*/ blo sbyong theg chen gyi chos kyi yang snying yin pas/ de bsgom pa la spro ba nyams pa med pa dang*/ theg pa che chung gi bslab bya phra mo tshun chad ma nyams par bsrung ba'o// 'bral med gsum dang ldan par bya// zhes pa ni/ lus ngag yid gsum dge ba dang mi 'bral bar byed pa'o// yul la phyogs med dag tu sbyang*// khyab dang gting 'byongs kun la gces// zhes pa ni/ yul sems can dang*/ sems can ma yin pa thams cad la phyogs ris med par blo sbyong ba dang*/ blo la gang shar ba thams cad la/ blo sbyong gis bya ba bar byas nas/ kha tshig tsam ma yin par gting nas 'byongs par byed pa'o// bkol ba rnams la rtag tu bsgom// zhes pa ni/ rang gi 'gran zlar 'dug pa dang*/ lhan cig tu 'grogs pa dang*/ phar gnod pa ma byas kyang tshur gnod pa byed pa dang*/ las kyi dbang gis snying du mi sdug pa la sogs pa gang skye dka' ba rnams la (211)lhag par byams snying rje bsgom zhing*/ bla ma dang pha ma la sogs pa yul gnyen pa rnams la gnod par 'gyur ba khyad par du spang bar bya'o// rkyen gzhan dag la ltos mi bya// zhes pa ni/ zas gos la sogs 'dzom pa dang*/ mi dang mi ma yin gyi gnod pa med pa dang*/ khams bzang ba la sogs pa mthun rkyen 'dzom pa la mi ltos par mthun rkyen ma 'dzom na ma 'dzom pa de nyid byang chub kyi sems gnyis kyi sgo nas lam du khyer ba'o// da res gtso bo nyams su blang*// zhes pa ni/ sngar thog ma med pa nas lus ji snyed blangs pa thams cad don med du song 'dug /da res kyi tshe 'di la don gyi gtso bo gcig bsgrub dgos par 'dug pas/

tshe 'di'i don bas chos gtso/ chos la bshad sgrub gnyis las/ sgrub pa gtso/ sgrub pa gzhan bas byang chub kyi sems sbyong ba gtso/ de'ang lung rig pa'i sgo nas sbyong ba bas/ bla ma'i man ngag la brten nas phur tshugs su sbyong ba gtso/ spyod lam gzhan bas mal du bsdad nas sbyong ba gtso/ yul spong ba bas/ gnyen po bsten pa gtso che bas gtso bo de rnams nyams su len pa'o// go log mi bya/ zhes pa ni/ go log drug spong ba ste/ chos bsgrub pa'i sdug bsngal mi bzod par dgra 'dul ba dang gnyen skyong ba la sogs pa'i dka' spyad bzod pa ni/ bzod pa go log go /chos rnam dag bsgrub pa la 'dun pa mi byed par tshe 'di'i dpal 'byor la 'dun pa byed pa ni/ 'dun pa go log go /thos bsam sgom gsum gyi sgo nas chos kyi ro mi myong bar/ 'jig rten gyi bde ba'i ro myong ba ni/ ro myong go log go /sdig pa byed pa la snying rje mi bsgom par/ chos phyir dka' thub byed pa la snying rje bsgom pa ni/ snying rje go log go /rang la ltos pa'i mi chos la mi sbyor bar/ tshe 'di'i (212)dpal 'byor che ba'i thabs la sbyor ba ni/ gnyer sems go log go /'khor 'das kyi bde ba dang dge ba la dga' ba mi bsgom par/ dgra la sdug bsngal byung na dga' ba bsgom pa ni/ rjes su yi rang go log ste// go log drug po spangs nas/ ma log pa drug nyams su blang ngo*// res 'jog mi bya/ zhes pa ni// chos la nges shes ma skyes pas// res byed res mi byed pa spangs nas/ rtse gcig tu rgyun mi 'chad par blo sbyong ba'o// dol chod du sbyong zhes pa ni/ blo sbyong nyid la blo lings bskyur nas phyogs gcig tu sbyong ba'o// brtag dpyad gnyis kyis thar bar bya// zhes pa ni/ rang rgyud la nyon mongs pa gang che brtags nas/ de 'bad pa drag pos spangs te/ de nas nyon mongs de skye ba'i yul la brten pa la sogs pa'i sgo nas/

de skye mi skye brtags te/ skyes na yang gnyen pos spangs shing*/ da mi skye bar 'gyur ba'i bar du 'bad par bya'o// yus ma bsgom/ zhes pa ni/ pha rol la bdag gi drin yod pa dang*/ rang gis chos yun ring la dos drag pa byas pa dang*/ mkhas pa dang btsun pa la sogs pa'i yus mi byed pa ste/ bdag pas gzhan gces bsgom pa la yus byas med pas so// mi la re ba ma che lha la gsol ba thob bya ba rwa sgreng pa'i bka' yin gsungs/ ko long ma sdom/ zhes pa ni bdag la gzhan gyis mi mang sar sma phab pa la sogs pa la lan mi bya zhing ko long mi bya'o// da ltar 'o skol chos pa rnams kyis chos bdag 'dzin gyi gnyen por ma song bas/ bzod bsran sha'u bas chung*/ ko long gtsang btsan bas dam par gda' ste// des chos kyi go mi chod pas/ chos bdag 'dzin gyi gnyen por 'gro ba zhig dgos gsungs/ yud tsam pa mi bya/ zhes pa ni/ cung zad la dga' mi dga'i rnam (213)'gyur ston pa ste/ grogs la gzan pas mi bya'o// 'or che ma 'dod/ ces pa ni/ gzhan la phan btags pa'am/ chos byas pa la tshig gi gtong rag dang*/ grags snyan la re ba med par bya'o// de ltar tshe hril gyis byang chub kyi sems rnam pa gnyis po mnyam rjes gnyis kyi sgo nas legs par sbyangs nas/ 'byongs pa'i gding thob par bya'o// snyigs ma lnga po bdo ba 'di// byang chub lam du bsgyur ba yin// man ngag bdud rtsi'i snying po 'di// gser gling pa nas brgyud pa yin// zhes pa ni/ dus dang sems can dang*/ tshe dang*/ nyon mongs pa dang*/ lta ba'i snyigs ma ste/ lnga bdo ba'i dus 'dir/ bde ba'i rkyen nyung*/ mi dang mi ma yin gyi 'tshe ba la sogs pa sdug bsngal gyi rkyen shin tu mang bas/ rkyen ngan gyi ru 'jing ba na/ de nyid blo sbyong gi grogs su byas nas blo sbyong bsgoms pas/ rkyen ngan ji tsam mang zhing dge sbyor 'phel bar 'gyur bas/ dug thams cad sman du bsgyur bar byed pa'i bdud rtsi lta bu/

bla ma gser gling pa'i man ngag 'di man ngag gzhan las khyad par du 'phags pa yin no// de ltar blo sbyong shes na grong khyer skyid pa'i 'byung gnas bya ba de yang*/ blo sbyong sgom pa'i lus 'di nyid la zer ba yin te/ rang gzhan gyi 'khor 'das kyi bde ba thams cad 'di las 'byung ba yin/ rtsom pa thams cad gcig tu dril nas/ sems dang chos 'dres par legs par blo sbyongs nas/ ring po mi thogs par rang gzhan gyi don phun sum tshogs pa thob par 'gyur ro zhes gsungs so// sngon sbyangs las kyi 'phro sad pas// rang gi mos pa mang ba'i rgyus// sdug bsngal gtam ngan khyad bsad nas// bdag 'dzin 'dul ba'i gdam ngag zhus// da ni shi yang mi 'gyod (214)do// zhes pa ni/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po 'chad kha bas/ thugs legs par sbyongs pas bdag pas gzhan gces kyi thugs/ rang 'dod kyi 'khri ba gtan nas med pa skyes pas gding thob pa'i gsung yin no// grags pa'i mtshan can chos rje'i bka' drin las// legs par rnyed pa'i snyan brgyud rin chen gter// dad ldan slob mas bskul nas phye ba'i mthus// 'gro kun byang chub sems gnyis 'byongs par shog /blo sbyong don bdun ma'i snyan brgyud kyi tshig rnams yi ge nyung ngu'i sgo nas bkrol ba 'di/ theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis yang dang yang du bskul nas/ btsun pa thogs med kyis dben gnas dngul chu'i chos rdzong du sbyar ba'o/// /
